notes.title: The Joy of Kimmy s childish dialogue
notes.content:
When young Dana meets Kimmy, she assumes that the 6-year-old must be a baby sent from the almighty. God gives people babies after all, according to Dana s mother. This kind of naive understanding defines Kimmy, a visual novel based on tales from the developer s own mother and narrated primarily by children. The premise is as simple as its dialogue. Set in 1968, it follows a young girl, Dana, as she babysits her neighbor, little Kimmy. The pair teach other neighborhood kids new street games in an effort to coax the shy Kimmy out of her comfort zone and make friends. But the joy of this story comes in how its characters talk to one another.

notes.title: Nina Freeman s babysit em up Kimmy is out now
notes.content: Interactive fiction game Kimmy [official site] is out now, and it’s got some serious pedigree behind it. It’s written by Nina Freeman, designer of Cibele, and illustrator Laura Knetzger, who worked with Freeman on the powerful Freshman Year. Set in 1960s Massachusetts, Kimmy has you play as Dana, a babysitter who’s worried about a little girl called Kimmy. It has a demo, if you fancy a go. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Kimmy Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
Hi all, Aaron here!

Ahead of the release of Kimmy next week, we've made the entire first day available as a demo. Your game save from the demo will carry over to the full version, so feel free to play as much as you like.

Have fun!

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28410036/f17012d7ae8dfcf988a2dd057081eccff3df3b3f.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28410036/c5cc4a549c5246129f408ea5c3fc0e7fa7e5ddef.png[/img][/url]


A sidenote: If you finish the demo and would like to play it again, you may do so by [i]deleting your save[/i] via the button in the Options menu. Please note that only your most recent save file will carry over to the full version!
